run_opt_bisect: run the opt-bisect-helper script to binary-search the maximum opt-bisect-limit that passes FileCheck
run_opt_bisect_custom_range: run the opt-bisect-helper with custom start and end range for bisecting opt-bisect-limit values
run_opt_bisect_custom_commands: run the opt-bisect-helper with custom opt and FileCheck command paths
run_opt_bisect_custom_prefix: run the opt-bisect-helper with a custom FileCheck prefix for matching check lines
run_opt_bisect_single_test: run the opt-bisect-helper on a single LLVM test file to find the optimal bisect limit
